T: Romance novel. Real jungle. Big lunch.
D: A romance writer is kidnapped by a billionaire who thinks she can find a lost treasure, and her cover model goes to rescue her.
P: Serve the snacks when Loretta and Alan bicker at the book launch.
S: Smoked salmon creme fraiche blinis and rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, and thin prosciutto wrapped around wedges of rockmelon, laid out on trays for the launch crowd.
the jungle on the remote island

Mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit cut into cups, squeezed with lime and sprinkled with a chilli and sea salt dust. Peel and cut 2 mangoes, half a papaya and half a pineapple into long batons. Stand them up in 4 cups. Grind 1 tsp chilli flakes with 1 tsp sea salt and 1 tsp caster sugar. Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fruit, spoon the pulp of 2 passionfruit on top and sprinkle with the chilli salt just before serving.
Coconut and panko crusted shrimp fried golden, with sweet chili sauce
Prawns dipped in egg and shredded coconut, fried at 180C until golden, with sweet chilli sauce.
M: Lime chili snapper grilled in banana leaf, with coconut rice and black beans
Snapper fillets rubbed with lime, garlic and chilli, grilled in banana leaves, with coconut rice and black beans.
Fairfax, the spoilt billionaire who kidnaps Loretta

Beef eye fillet roasted pink and sliced thick, with a rich tarragon béarnaise, crispy smashed potatoes and grilled asparagus. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat, drizzle with oil and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Sear a seasoned 1kg eye fillet and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then rest. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with a chopped eschalot to 1 tbsp. Whisk 3 egg yolks with the reduction over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in 180g melted butter and add chopped tarragon. Grill 2 bunches asparagus.
W: Homemade mango lime sorbet, scraped and frozen, scooped into glasses
Ripe mango, lime juice and sugar syrup blended smooth, frozen in a tray and scraped every hour until set, scooped into glasses with passionfruit on top.
K: Coconut water, pineapple juice, mint and lime over ice, no alcohol
Coconut water, pineapple juice and lime over ice with mint.

steps.text: Slice the beetroot as thin as you can and toss with the lemon juice and salt.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of beetroot and chives.
Peel the zucchini into long ribbons, brush with the oil and paprika and sear quickly in a hot pan. Cool.
Cut the rockmelon into neat wedges, remove the skin and wrap each with a zucchini ribbon.
Lay both out on trays in rows.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Dip each in beaten egg, then press into the mixed coconut and panko.
Fry in the oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and crisp, in batches. Serve with the sweet chilli sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick fingers.
Dip each in beaten egg, then press into the mixed coconut and panko.
Fry in the oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and crisp, in batches.
Serve hot with the sweet chilli sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

steps.text: Rub the snapper with the lime juice, garlic, chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf.
Grill for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt. Warm the black beans.
Serve the fish in its leaf.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

steps.text: Mix the lime juice, garlic, chilli and oil and coat the haloumi. Wrap two slices in each softened banana leaf.
Grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until the haloumi is soft and golden.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with the salt. Warm the black beans.

dishes.make_ahead: Make a day ahead, scrape and serve fresh

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Blend the mango flesh with the syrup and lime juice until smooth.
Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours.
Scoop into glasses and top with passionfruit pulp.
Fill tall glasses with ice and a few mint leaves.
Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, squeeze in a lime wedge and stir well.

s.note: Smoked salmon creme fraiche blinis and rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto
s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of smoked salmon and snipped chives. Cut a rockmelon into neat wedges, remove the skin and wrap each with a thin slice of prosciutto. Lay both out on trays in rows for the book launch crowd.

s.note: Coconut and panko crusted shrimp fried golden, with sweet chili sauce
s.how: Peel 500g green prawns, leaving the tails on. Dip each in beaten egg, then press into a mix of shredded coconut and panko breadcrumbs. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain on paper and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.

m.note: Lime chili snapper grilled in banana leaf, with coconut rice and black beans
m.how: Rub 4 snapper fillets with lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill for 10 minutes. Cook rice in coconut milk with a pinch of salt, and warm a can of black beans. Serve the fish in its leaf.

w.note: Homemade mango lime sorbet, scraped and frozen, scooped into glasses
w.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with the syrup and the juice of 2 limes until smooth. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours. Scoop into glasses and top with passionfruit pulp.

d.note: Coconut water, pineapple juice, mint and lime over ice, no alcohol
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice and a few mint leaves. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir well and serve cold, the kind of drink you need after hiking out of a jungle.
